title: Dembow Shaker Ghost
description: A crisp 16th-note shaker groove built entirely from filtered white noise — tight hat envelope with near-zero decay. Brightness, pan sway, and accent dynamics morph on mutually-prime LFO clocks (7, 11, 13, 17 cycles) so the top-end shimmer shifts continuously without ever repeating. Dry and punchy with a slow hpf sweep that opens the sizzle across the loop.
